description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes between Flight Attendants Union, Colombo 05 Vs Sri Lanka Airlines Limited, Colombo 01. and Mr. Kalmuthu Thiyagaraja Colombo 13 Vs Tissa Resort (Pvt) Limited
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically the revocation and issuance of orders for arbitration in industrial disputes. It references specific legal provisions (Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act), involves statutory instruments, and deals with regulatory procedures for dispute resolution. While it mentions a minister's name (Manusha Nanayakkara), it does so in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than describing detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
